description:
Compare the performance of Fixed Speed vs Variable Speed wind turbine control strategies.

1. Open QBlade and load the sample project 'HAWT_Review.wpa' (or any valid HAWT sample).
2. Navigate to the Turbine BEM Simulation module.
3. Define a new turbine named 'Fixed_Turbine' with Regulation Type 'Fixed Rotational Speed' at 30 RPM.
4. Run a simulation for 'Fixed_Turbine' (range 3-25 m/s) and name it 'Sim_Fixed'.
5. Define a second turbine named 'Variable_Turbine' with Regulation Type 'Variable Rotational Speed' (Optimized Cp) and Design TSR 7.0.
6. Run a simulation for 'Variable_Turbine' (range 3-25 m/s) and name it 'Sim_Variable'.
7. Export the simulation results (Power vs Wind Speed tables) for both simulations to:
   - /home/ga/Documents/fixed_power_curve.txt
   - /home/ga/Documents/variable_power_curve.txt

Ensure the exported data includes Rotational Speed columns.
